events: When o_c_n mentions being short prey at the Gathering, c_n doesn't hesitate to donate a piece of territory to them.
c_n's leader offers o_c_n a piece of territory that their warriors were having trouble keeping up with. o_c_n accepts.
o_c_n negotiates with c_n at the Gathering and leaves with an additional piece of territory.
o_c_n has started hunting on a piece of c_n's territory. c_n's leader, trying to avoid conflict, has decided to just give o_c_n the land.
Rumour has it that c_n's newest piece of territory, taken from o_c_n, wasn't acquired through any peaceful means.
c_n's leader travels to o_c_n's camp to negotiate for some territory, but leaves empty-pawed.
o_c_n denies c_n's request at the Gathering for hunting rights on their territory.
c_n tries to convince o_c_n to paw over a piece of territory. o_c_n's leader just scoffs.
o_c_n laughs in their face as c_n's leader asks to trade for a piece of territory.
